request.message:
Okay, we need to build a workflow from Grass Valley. We will receive two SRT feeds. They will each go through Uplynk and land in a single live event. We are doing two in parallel for redundancy.
The event is for the Super Bowl. We will broadcast it OTT and it will also go out to YouTube as well as to three other syndication partners. YouTube will receive Dash, Poole, the other syndication partners. We will push SRT feed to them over Zixi.

Additionally, another partner is going to feed us an HLS stream and that will follow a different path which will go through Uplynk and into a linear channel with scheduling enabled and that will go out OTT 24-7.

reply: Set up two SRT feeds through a shared Grass Valley master control, each with its own ingest/transcode chain for redundancy, both landing in one Super Bowl live event that fans out to OTT, YouTube, and three Zixi syndication partners. The "YouTube will receive Dash, Poole" part didn't map to anything usable so I left YouTube as a plain social output — worth double-checking what that meant. Also added the HLS partner feed as its own path into a scheduled 24/7 channel with a separate OTT output, since live events and channels can't share one OTT per the platform rules.
summary: Built a redundant dual-SRT path through Grass Valley into a single Super Bowl live event branching to OTT, YouTube and three Zixi syndication partners, plus a separate HLS partner path through ABR transmux into a scheduled 24/7 linear channel with its own OTT output.
